description: Display of a value with optional label, change and trend.

howToUse: Use it for the main numbers of a dashboard or plan: revenue, active users, limit per minute.
Write the name in `label`, the number in `value` and the unit in `unit`. Explain the number in `description` when it is not obvious.
Show the change with `delta` and a small trend in `chart`. Your application calculates both.

keyboard.action: The number does not receive focus. Screen readers read the name, the value and the change.

props.name: label
props.description: Mono uppercase label above the number. E.g. "Rate limit".

props.name: value
props.description: Main value (large tabular number). E.g. "3,700" or "60 req/min".

props.name: unit
props.description: Smaller suffix next to the value. E.g. "credits", "/ 2,500".

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary line under the value. E.g. "per API key, 429 when exceeded".

props.name: delta
props.description: Change with up/down arrow and semantic color.

props.name: chart
props.description: Mini chart slot (e.g. `<Sparkline />` from Charts) under the content.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

examples.description: Tile grid as in "Usage limits" on the Developer page.
examples.code:
import { Card } from '@refy-design/web';
import { CardHeader } from '@refy-design/web';
import { Stat } from '@refy-design/web';
import { StatGroup } from '@refy-design/web';
export function Example() {
  return (
    <Card style={{ maxWidth: 640 }}>
      <CardHeader title="Usage limits" />
      <StatGroup>
        <Stat
          size="sm"
          label="Rate limit"
          value="60"
          unit="req/min"
          description="per API key, 429 once exceeded."
        />
        <Stat
          size="sm"
          label="Parallel analyses"
          value="3"
          unit="concurrent"
          description="Pro plan · upgrading unlocks 10."
        />
        <Stat
          size="sm"
          label="Webhook timeout"
          value="10s"
          unit="· 5 retries"
          description="exponential backoff 30s → 4h."
        />
      </StatGroup>
    </Card>
  );
}
